name: bluesky
description: Let your agent research Bluesky: search posts, read threads, profiles, feeds, starter packs, trends and your notifications, and publish a post you approved.

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: Bluesky
examples: Search Bluesky for what people say about Unreal camera tools this month
Find the starter packs and custom feeds game developers on Bluesky read
Show me my Bluesky mentions, replies and quotes since yesterday

setup.title: Create a Bluesky app password
setup.detail: In Bluesky, open Settings, Privacy and security, App passwords, and add one named Dimension. Leave direct-message access off. An app password can read and post but cannot change your account, and you can revoke it any time.

setup.title: Enter your handle and the app password
setup.detail: Your full handle without the @ (brand.com or you.bsky.social). The plugin signs in once and keeps the session on this machine, refreshing it instead of signing in again. Your main password is never needed.

form.label: App password
form.help: The app password you just created, not your account password.

tools.name: bluesky_search_posts
tools.description: Search posts as your connected account (Bluesky closed keyless post search): top or latest, date, author, mention, language, domain, link and tag filters, with each post's numbers and a hit estimate.

tools.name: bluesky_get_posts
tools.description: Read up to 25 posts by link with their likes, reposts, replies, quotes and bookmarks. No account needed.

tools.name: bluesky_thread
tools.description: Read a post in its conversation: parents, the post and its replies. No account needed.

tools.name: bluesky_quotes
tools.description: List the posts that quote a post. No account needed.

tools.name: bluesky_profile
tools.description: Read an account: followers, follows, posts, join date, bio, labels, and the starter packs, feeds and lists it made. No account needed.

tools.name: bluesky_author_feed
tools.description: Read one account's recent posts with each post's numbers. No account needed.

tools.name: bluesky_find_feeds
tools.description: Find custom feeds about a topic, most liked first. No account needed.

tools.name: bluesky_find_starter_packs
tools.description: Find starter packs by name with how many people joined through each this week and all time. No account needed.

tools.name: bluesky_trends
tools.description: Read what is trending on Bluesky now. No account needed.

tools.name: bluesky_my_notifications
tools.description: Read your account's mentions, replies and quotes (or likes, reposts, follows) without marking them read.

tools.name: bluesky_publish
tools.description: Publish a post or thread you approved on Traction's campaign board, with its images and alt text. It refuses anything the board did not approve, and asks you before it sends.
